description: Using the chaos as cover, the agents blend into the crowd pouring out of the exhibition hall. Inspiration dice checks guide the escape route, revealing and thwarting a conspiracy that spans the ages in a high-stakes gamble of life and death.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Pushing through the crowd amidst the throng.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Make an Idea roll.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player3>'s Idea check result:

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew tucks the pistol into his pocket and runs with the group.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The mountains and soil hear your wishes; regardless of what karma and retribution may be, fate now slumbers in your palm.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David puts the pistol back into his coat pocket, planning to drop it at the feet of the crowd if the situation turns bad.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Gray and Andrew, a familiar feeling surges in your hearts. Your perception of time begins to become chaotic, shifting from a steady flow to a disordered turbulence. One second is compressed to infinitesimal, the next is stretched to millions of years; soon, you find your bodies have lost the ability to perceive time—how long has it been now? A dozen seconds or millions of years?

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew's world has developed a critical malfunction.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: At the same time, you all vaguely realize that the flow of time begins to differ at different heights in space, like cutting a cake into several "layers" with different flow rates. The closer to the ceiling, the faster the flow. This leads to some terrifying consequences.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: But lying down in such a situation is basically asking for death.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Sensing something wrong, Alison quickly stops and observes the surroundings.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: At the same time, you suddenly realize: the light has changed.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player4>'s Willpower check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Those with a mathematics background, additional SAN loss 1/1d3.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player3>'s Willpower check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You feel a churning in your stomach and a buzzing in your ears because you "understand" their mode of existence better than others.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: This is not an experience vocational school should have; this is the price of learning.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Let me see, you are good at quite a few things.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew struggles not to fall down. Once down, he might never get up again.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: With the experience of the strange cottage, recent encounters with various black magic, and just witnessing Haddin being torn into pieces before her eyes, Alison deeply feels this supernatural power.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player4>'s Willpower check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You are utterly terrified out of your wits by this unprecedented horror.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Gray seems already mentally dazed. David desperately squeezes to his comrade's side, pulling her to avoid being knocked down by the crowd and trampled to death.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Initial state: The three in the front row are in Area C.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Half-crouching, starting to run for it.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David desperately starts walking towards Gray's position.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: First round Dexterity roll.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player3>'s Dexterity check result:

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew is close to David, so he'll help carry him while retreating first.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Let me see, you are good at quite a few things.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Gray isn't involved for now; Andrew takes David and retreats first.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Let me see, you're quite skilled at many things.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: At least everyone has met up in area B. Advance together!

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Second round Dexterity:

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The cycle of fate is like shackles, and you're about to gamble on that elusive one now?

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Meanwhile, I'll roll a secret die.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player3>'s Dexterity check result:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Before running, David takes the mirror from Gray's embrace. Very sorry, but we still have to live.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Third round Dexterity.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player6>'s Dexterity check result:

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Stuck in place!

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player4>'s Willpower check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: This round's action.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David desperately grabs Andrew's arm with one hand, while protecting the mirror in his embrace with the other, running out.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player4>'s Dexterity check result:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Forcefully drag Andrew and run together towards the evacuation point.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Let me see, you're quite skilled at many things.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Fourth round Dexterity.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player5>'s Dexterity check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Fifth round Dexterity.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player5>'s Dexterity check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player5 dashes out with lightning speed.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: run boy run.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Before leaving, Alison looks back to see if the journalist lady who provided us great help has safely reached the exit.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You've just survived a disaster and are panting heavily.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Without a word, immediately stuff the bag and get in the car.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Mumble and run onto the car holding the mirror.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Still shaken, holding chest and running to the car.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: She probably ran away long ago, but good that she did, covering our tracks.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You board the car with joyful hearts, the door locks with a "click" like a coffin closing.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Check if that son of a bitch player5 is here.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: A brief pause, as if the other party is waiting for you to recognize his voice.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Check if that son of a bitch player5 is here.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Whose voice is this, who, do we know them?

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Unfortunately, player5 is not with you. Apparently, he might be watching this desperate struggle from outside the glass right now.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David thinks about it. We're rookie agents, that makes sense.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: As the words end, the timer above the mirror starts ticking, beginning the countdown—02:59, 02:58, 02:57…

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison is searching for the poison pill in her mouth.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Nocton's voice sounds again:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David also starts probing his back molar with his tongue.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Does Andrew have something like that?

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Today I will take 0 to 3 of you. To be precise, the final number of people who can walk out of this room must not equal three."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew is somewhat at a loss, sitting on the bed.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The voice cuts off abruptly, as if it never existed.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: When he hears this ultimatum, Andrew cries out loudly.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Has David found his poison pill?

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Mom! I want stew!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Oh, by the way, player5, why not try to persuade your life-and-death friends here?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: He begins to look desperately at his two colleagues, waiting to see what they will do.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison looks back at her colleagues and starts quickly assembling the pistol.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Unable to find the poison pill, David starts assembling the pistol.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You've found the poison pill located at your back molar with your tongue, but is this really the right thing to do?

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew lies flat on the bed and starts singing nursery rhymes.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Nocton hands the microphone to you, with a faint, ambiguous smile.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Assembling the pistol is quick, David should have it put together soon.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "We ate this, this, and this. This one was probably pre-treated, maybe using this method, plus the marinade."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Requires a successful Pistol or Mechanical Repair roll.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player3>'s Pistol check result:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I'm sorry for what you see as betrayal, but I'd rather you survive. Without Comrade Nocton's help, relying solely on us, it would clearly be difficult to find an opportunity to clear our names."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "The texture was excellent, probably processed this way and that, but I'm not sure. I think we can try other methods, like using... to simulate it, the effect should be similar."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Then I'll bite. "If possible, kill that son of a bitch for me."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "player5, can you send a few assembled pistols? My eyes are ruined by the smoke grenade, I can't put them together."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison bit the poison pill in her mouth.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Alison, don't do anything foolish."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Whether from my personal feelings or the organization's perspective, I don't want you to give up your lives like this."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "To be honest, this dish isn't as stunning as the one we had on the first day, but it's also very distinctive. The method and ingredients are more homely, easier to replicate."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "It wasn't the Soviets who put us in such danger—they even rescued me and Andrew from the Freikorps—it was those damned Germans."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Maybe I should have gone back to being a doctor. I thought this line of work would let me save more people, but I don't seem to have that much ability."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: @player4 "Click."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Ali, Ali!!" David had no mood to continue dealing with player5. He took a swift step and caught Alison as she fell.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew continued lying in bed. He heard his colleagues assembling firearms, while he was here reciting recipes and acting spoiled.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Damn it... Couldn't it be made tastier..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Your lungs are burning, as if inhaling air filled with steel needles. Every breath becomes torture. Your hands won't stop shaking, your legs can no longer stand steady.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison squeezed out her last few words through gritted teeth.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: He heard David calling Ms. Gray's name, forcing him to jump out of bed too, to check on Ms. Gray who had been taking care of him.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I admire your integrity, Ms. Alison."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "So there's this too, I forgot we had this..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Almighty Father, receive this servant Alison Gray according to your holy and good will..."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew holds no loyalty to the Queen, but with one person lying on the ground and two kneeling beside her, it makes him want to taste the almond flavor too.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "What a pity. From Margaret's perspective, I'm sorry, Gray. Perhaps under different identities, we could have been friends having afternoon tea, but you gave up your choice..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David held his companion in his arms. "...deliver her from the evils of war, as you showed mercy to the thief on the cross."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "No more stew, no more stew..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "By the baptism she received in her Christian name, Alison Gray."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Should we commit suicide too?" Andrew looked at David.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Andrew, if you want to kill yourself, suit yourself. Only cowards do such things." David was heartbroken but could only encourage his little brother.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "%*——_!" Andrew mumbled something unintelligible, then threw himself onto the dead Gray and cried bitterly.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Now there are fewer than three people." David shouted into the microphone.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Margaret fell silent for a moment, then let out a sigh whose meaning no one could decipher. "Humans are like reeds, life can be easily taken, but are there things more precious than life...?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Stew! I want to eat stew!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The room door opens. You can leave this hell now.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "player5, how do you usually calm this little brother down? My God, I can't handle it." David muttered.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew clung to the dead Gray, refusing to leave.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "...I usually don't calm him down."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Then carry her on your back." David rubbed his temples. "Find a good cemetery for burial."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The door opened.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "There's a second one?" David brushed off his clothes.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: He raised a finger and pointed to the corner. The camera installed there was still flashing red, unabashedly declaring: everything about you has been recorded.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Then sign it, seems there's no other way. David accepted it well. "Did he get a military rank because he rolled earlier?" He pointed at player5.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Captain player5 is more capable and more reliable in character." The corner of his mouth curved up.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew also signed while crying.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "More reliable in character." David said sarcastically.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: His gaze swept over you: "You are the eyes we send back, the moles. From now on, you have two names, two layers of faith, one life."
